'''Temple Quartermaster''' was a title used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] given to a member of the Order stationed at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. The quartermaster was responsible for the dissemination and maintenance of all field equipment used by Jedi active on missions for the Order.

Equipment commonly carried by Jedi in the field usually consisted of their personal [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], survival rations in the form of capsules, a [[Hush-98 comlink/Legends|Hush-98]] [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a [[Fibercord/Legends|fibercord]] grappling hook and/or a [[Liquid-cable launcher/Legends|grappling spike launcher]], a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] (such as an [[Imagecaster/Legends|Imagecaster]]), a [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]], an [[A99 aquata breather/Legends|A99 aquata breather]], and other specialized equipment.

[[File:JediBelt-CVD.jpg|left|thumb|A stocked [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] utility belt.]]
